questions.question: Of the four words given, three have a certain type of similarity and one is odd. Select that odd option.
questions.solution:

Thus calm is the odd one out.

Hence, **Calm** is the correct answer.

questions.question: The difference between simple interest and compound interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is Rs. 732. Find the sum.
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

For 2 years 

C.I. - S.I. = P( R² over 100²)

Where,

C.I. = compound interest

S.I. = simple interest

R = rate%

P = principal sum

**Given:**

C.I. - S.I. = 732

Rate = 10%

Time = 2 years

**Calculation:**

732 = P ( 10 ×10 over 100 × 100)

732 = P/100

P = 73200

Hence, 73200 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(4, 19, 41)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

squaring the 1st number then add 3 to it, we get the 2nd number.

Multiply the 2nd number with 2 then add 3 to it, we get the 3rd number.

4² + 3 

= 16 + 3

= 19

and 19 × 2 + 3

= 38 + 3

= 41

Only option 1 follows this pattern.

8² + 3

= 64 + 3

= 67

and 67 × 2 + 3

= 134 + 3

= 137

Hence, **(8, 67, 137)** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter on the face opposite to the showing 'B'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cc6352927529385a32d11f9c13716e0f8b8981ff2ac64e3700d242e28496265.png]
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

The 3 adjacent faces of the dice which we see will never be the opposite among them.

In figure 1, Adjacent of B is D, F

In figure 2, Adjacent of B is C, D.

In figure 4, Adjacent of B is A, C.

This will never be the opposite of B.

Only remaining alphabet is E, which becomes the opposite of B.

Hence, **E** is the correct answer.
